0022600125.text: The Atlanta Hawks (2-1, 1st in the Southeast, 3rd in the East) come into this road game on a one-game losing streak, having won both of their away games while dropping their only home game so far. They face the Houston Rockets (3-0, 1st in the Southwest, 3rd in the West), who are riding a three-game winning streak. Atlanta will be without Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), while Houston is missing Steven Adams (calf strain) and has Marcus Smart listed as day-to-day with a forearm strain and a game-time decision. The Rockets won the last meeting 121-114 in Atlanta, and the Hawks trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after losing 0-2 to Houston in 2025-26.
